We need to return mapped_rxn and template_id for the template that when applied to the molecule (target) reproduces the reaction described: Friedel-Crafts acylation, halide functional group is gone. We have prior step: make_6_lvl2-apply_template-1 gave answer list of precursors: [['COc1cccc(Cl)c1', 'NC(=O)c1nnn(Cc2ccc(CN3CC(F)C3)cc2)c1N']]. That means the target molecule is something? The apply_template step likely applied a template to target and got precursors. So we need to return the mapped_rxn associated with that template. So we need to find which template produced those precursors. We have the list of precursors: first is COc1cccc(Cl)c1 (a chlorophenyl with methoxy). second is NC(=O)c1nnn(Cc2ccc(CN3CC(F)C3)cc2)c1N (some heterocycle with amide). The target molecule likely is product of Friedel-Crafts acylation: aromatic ring with acyl group attached (maybe from acyl chloride). The halide is gone (Cl removed). So template likely breaks a C-Cl bond and forms C-C bond to carbonyl carbon.

We need to search template catalog with criteria: functional_groups_broken includes "halide", functional_groups_formed includes "acyl". Also bond formed 6-6? aromatic carbon to carbonyl carbon (sp2-sp2). Let's search.
